title: Instacart reportedly discussed selling itself with DoorDash and Uber | TechCrunch
summary: Instacart might sell itself to a larger competitor, according to multiple news reports The Information reported Friday that the grocery delivery company has hired an investment bank to help it evaluate its options, and that it’s held acquisition talks with DoorDash.
